All actions are possible for stacks that have the "normal" order. The stack is free to move wherever it wants and will attack enemy stacks/cities, pick up bags, visit sites, etc.
Other than defending itself when it is attacked, a stack that has the "stand" order will not move or do anything on the map. It just stays there until it is attacked.

The only valid action for a stack with the order "guard" is to attack enemy stacks that are within a %QTY%x%QTY% area around itself. Stacks in the guarded area that have the order "stand" will be ignored.
A stack that has the "guard" order will ignore all other objects on the map (bags, cities, sites, resources, etc...)

A stack that has the "Attack stack" order will try to destroy its target as soon as it possibly can. It will only attack other stacks if they are blocking the way to its target. If a bag is in the way, it will be picked up.
Once the target stack has been destroyed, the order of the stack will change to "Berserk".

This order instructs a stack to attack any enemy stack that moves within a %QTY%x%QTY% area around the defended stack. When possible, the defender will try to remain close to the stack it is defending. If an enemy is preventing the stack from reaching

the stack to defend, it will be attacked. If a bag is blocking the way, it will be picked up. When the stack to defend gets killed, this order changes to "Roam" for neutral stacks and to "Normal" for stacks owned by a playable race.

In order to secure the city it is assigned to, a stack with this order will try to reach and enter the city as soon as it can. If enemy stacks or bags are blocking its way, the stack will deal with them accordingly.
Once inside the city, the stack will stay there to defend it. Stacks with the "Secure city" order will not take other map objects (sites, resources, etc...) into consideration.

A stack that is assigned this order will roam the lands seeking for a safe city to inhabit, with the possibility of attacking enemy stacks and cities as well as picking up close-by bags. It will not interact with other
map objects such as sites and resources. Once the stack enters a city, it will stay there.
The stack will move to the center of the specified location, picking up bags and attacking other stacks that are in its way. No other interactions with map objects are allowed.
Once the stack has reached its target position, its order will change to "Stand".
A stack that is assigned this order will attack enemy stacks within the specified location. The size of the location is used to determine which stacks to attack. If there are

no stacks to attack, the defending stack will try to move to the center of the location, picking up bags or attacking enemies that are blocking the way. No other interation with map objects is possible.
A berserk stack will attack any enemy stack or city in sight. It will not interact with sites and ruins, and it will not pick up bags unless one is in its way.
